title: The Spotlight preview is a real phone, and each link shows in the style you pick

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-20 (project thread: Redesign the Spotlight editor): 'This preview is goofy AF' and 'The style changed does nothing'.

detail: The editor sat in the 760px focus column, so the preview frame was squeezed narrower than a phone: titles wrapped and the main button spilled out of its pill. The editor now uses the whole console width and the preview is drawn at a real phone's 390 by 844, scaled to fit the column and the window, with the page's own colour filling the screen below a short page. Link styles: New World drew every link as a card and always made the first link the big main button, so picking Text link did nothing. The Links block default style now reaches the theme, each link carries its own style, text links draw as underlined links, buttons as secondary buttons, cards as cards, and the main button is the link marked main, else the first link that is not a text link or card.

verify.note: Fails while the preview is not a scaled 390 phone, the editor sits in the narrow column, or New World ignores link styles.
